data.title: fix: worklist-integration truncate hides Item title (▸ + colour makes line overflow 80cols)

data.author: pi
data.comment:
pi - Session ID: herdr-1788850301-2736720-17070 - /home/rgardler/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-rgardler-projects-ContextHub--/2026-09-08T06-51-41-857Z_herdr-1788850301-2736720-17070.jsonl

Implemented and delivered to dev as f2aa167f. Full-scope suite now ALL GREEN (the owned AC1 failure is gone).

Root cause: commit 8cd160cc colour-coded each row's item ID with its own full \x1b[0m reset. For SELECTED rows (wrapped in reverse video) that interior reset cleared the reverse attribute mid-row (only the prefix stayed highlighted) and worklist-integration's selectedRowText() helper, matching non-greedily up to the FIRST reset, truncated the extracted row at the coloured ID — 'Item C' became just 'C'.

Fix (2 files, +26/−6):
- worklist.ts: new reverseWrap() re-asserts reverse video after every interior \x1b[0m so the whole selected row stays highlighted; heading rows (no interior resets) are byte-identical to before.
- worklist-integration.test.ts: selectedRowText() now extracts the entire reverse-video line and strips all SGR codes rather than stopping at the first reset.

Verified: worklist-integration AC1/AC2/AC3 + worklist-renderer-headings + worklist/heading-rows/group-toggle + form-dialog + code-freeze-dialog + detail-view + fetcher-memo + claim suites all pass; herdr tsc clean; implement.py finish full-scope gate green.
